- In the previous session (Session 2), I successfully booked the meeting for Thursday at 14:30 based on Brad's confirmation of availability.
- I then notified Brad in the workspace that the booking was made and he could proceed with sending the confirmation email.
- The task is considered complete only when the booking is created *and* the confirmation email has been sent.

Current status:

- I am waiting for Brad to send the email.
- There are no new messages from Brad in the workspace. This means he hasn't yet confirmed that the email has been sent.

- However, I have done everything I can. I have no further actions to take. I cannot send the email myself, and I have already informed Brad.
- Sending another message to Brad now would be redundant and inefficient, as he just received my last message 30 minutes ago in the simulation time. He might be processing it in his own session.
- The best course of action is to simply wait. I will end my session and check for updates from Brad in the next one. This conserves my available sessions and actions.My part of the task is complete. The meeting has been booked, and I've notified Brad so he can send the confirmation email. I will wait for him to complete his part.
